name: Pin day high
note: Chartink translation, 4 Nov 2026 (Saurabh's 15-minute pin-bar scan, the two 'at the day's high' groups): the forming 15m bar's range is more than 3x its body, it has no lower wick (a green bar opening at its low, or a red bar closing at its low: Chartink's groups 1 and 3), and its high is the day's high. A long upper wick rejected at the high of the day. Stop = the bar's high (the day high), target at twice the risk.
